A FEW SWEET DETAILS

Good to know
before you order.

Storage tips, payments and our cancellation policy are all on the FAQ page.

See all FAQs
How far ahead should I order?

Please give Pasha one week’s notice. Every cookie is made to order, so a little planning helps make your box extra special. Need cookies sooner? Email pashabakess@gmail.com and Pasha will let you know what’s possible.

Where do I pick up my cookies?

Pickup only in Tyngsboro, MA, normally between 10am and 7pm (Eastern time). You choose your pickup time when you order. The exact address is included in your confirmation email once your payment is verified. Delivery and shipping are not offered.

Can I mix and match the flavors?

Yes! Choose any mix from the current menu. Boxes are available as 4 cookies for $14, 6 for $20, 12 for $38, 24 for $76, or 36 for $114. The minimum order is 4 cookies. For orders above 3 dozen (36 cookies), email Pasha to arrange whole dozens and confirm pricing.

Are the cookies suitable for food allergies?

Pashabakess is not allergen-free. Our cookies are not free of peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, dairy/eggs, soy, or food coloring, so they are not suitable for peanut, tree nut, gluten, dairy/egg, soy, or food coloring allergies. Everything is prepared in the same kitchen using shared equipment, trays, utensils, and packaging areas. Because cross-contact can happen, I do not recommend ordering or sharing the cookies with anyone with food allergies.

Are your ingredients halal?

Yes. All ingredients used in Pashabakess cookies are halal, including items such as marshmallows. If you have a question about a specific ingredient, please email Pasha before ordering.
